purpose: Use Hardware Splicer on itself to discover, specify, design, verify, manufacture, benchmark, and potentially sell a hardware product.

evidence: architecture correction: generic load switch replaced by explicit current-limited reverse-protected TPS2553 path because the original concept did not enforce the <=250 mA contract
schematic-generator correction: 5.08 mm label stubs on compact vertical passives overlapped and merged GND with 1V1; passive stubs reduced and complete pin/net contract verification added
toolchain reproducibility correction: safety-critical INA219 and RP2040 symbol identities pinned project-locally after distro KiCad library drift/load failures

USB-C generator correction: stock stacked-pin symbol produced ambiguous native KiCad connectivity; PF-001 now uses a project-local unstacked logical USB-C symbol preserving every physical pin number while exact production MPN/footprint remain pending.

claim_boundary: A PASS through SELECT/SPECIFY means only that the concept warrants engineering time. It is not evidence of physical correctness, demand, incumbent replacement, revenue, or commercial superiority.

status_vocabulary.rule: BLOCKED is reserved for an actual defect, contradiction, safety stop, or failed verification. Healthy downstream sequencing uses READY_*, QUEUED_AFTER_*, AWAITING_*, EVIDENCE_PENDING_*, ACTIVE_*, or PASS_*.
